Technical safety requirement: Compute the safe longitudinal distance to every road user and obstacle ahead that CMP-03 reports, from the current speed and the assumptions of P-06, plus the margin P-01
Verification: Formal check of the distance rule; unit tests over the speed range; scenario tests with braking vehicles ahead

Technical safety requirement: Limit commanded acceleration to the envelope for the current speed, and to zero or braking while any distance of TSR-01.01 is below the safe distance
Verification: Fault injection of excessive acceleration commands in HIL; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: When a distance of TSR-01.01 is below the safe distance and the commanded deceleration does not restore it, command the deceleration that does, up to emergency level; never command emergency level otherwise
Verification: Fault injection of insufficient braking commands; scenario tests; review that no other path commands emergency level

Technical safety requirement: Predict the swept path over the stopping time and reject motion that crosses the predicted path of a reported road user before the vehicle could stop or clear it, using the bounds of P-07
Verification: Scenario tests at intersections, roundabouts and crosswalks with road users at the bounds of P-07

Technical safety requirement: Where CMP-03 reports an occluded zone beside the path, limit speed so the vehicle can stop for a road user emerging from it at the bounds of P-07
Verification: Scenario tests past parked vehicles and blind corners; review of the occlusion model

Technical safety requirement: Apply TSR-01.02 to TSR-01.05 to remote driving commands in the same way as to Autoware's
Verification: Fault injection of unsafe remote commands in HIL

Technical safety requirement: Deliver measured speed with the accuracy the safe distance of TSR-01.01 assumes
Verification: Supplier evidence under the DIA; comparison with a reference on the vehicle

Technical safety requirement: Limit commanded steering angle and steering rate to the envelope P-10 for the current speed
Verification: Fault injection of steering commands beyond the envelope; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Reject a steering command whose swept path, over the stopping time, comes within the margin P-02 of a road user, obstacle or kerb that CMP-03 reports, and stop in lane instead
Verification: Scenario tests with oncoming traffic, cyclists alongside and kerbs; fault injection of steering commands

Technical safety requirement: Detect achieved acceleration above the bounded command, beyond the tolerance P-11, and then cut propulsion and stop in lane
Verification: Fault injection of unintended propulsion on the vehicle side; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Detect achieved deceleration below the commanded, beyond the tolerance P-11, and switch to the secondary brake path
Verification: Fault injection of a primary brake path shortfall; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Detect achieved steering differing from the commanded beyond the tolerance P-11, and stop in lane
Verification: Fault injection of steering deviations; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: When CMP-03 reports itself failed, let Autoware stop in lane comfortably, compare its speed, deceleration and steering with the vehicle state, and stop the vehicle itself if it does not slow as expected
Verification: Fault injection of a safety channel failure with and without a following Autoware fault

Technical safety requirement: Accept the monitor's switch to the secondary brake path and the propulsion cut within the reaction budget
Verification: Supplier evidence under the DIA; vehicle test with timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Limit a deceleration command from Autoware above the firm level P-05 to that level unless CMP-03 reports a road user or obstacle that requires more
Verification: Fault injection of spurious hard braking; replay of scenes with and without a confirming object

Technical safety requirement: Report with every frame whether a road user or obstacle in the path ahead requires braking above the firm level P-05
Verification: Replay of recorded scenes; detection tests

Technical safety requirement: Detect a lost, late, repeated, out-of-sequence or implausible command from Autoware, and start MRM-4
Verification: Fault injection of lost, late, repeated and corrupted commands; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: In REMOTE mode, reject a command older than the age bound P-09, out of sequence or failing its signature check (CSR-01), and start MRM-4
Verification: Fault injection of aged, replayed and unsigned remote commands; measurement of command age over the cellular links

Technical safety requirement: Keep a clock for command age that is synchronised with the remote operations station and whose own error counts against the age bound P-09
Verification: Clock drift and loss-of-synchronisation tests

Technical safety requirement: On MRM-4, decelerate in lane at the firm level P-05 to standstill with hazard lights on, raised only as TSR-01.03 requires, and hold
Verification: Vehicle tests of MRM-4 from the speed range on dry and wet roads

Technical safety requirement: At standstill, hold service and park brake until doors are closed, CMP-03 reports the near field clear in the direction of travel, and a motion request in the selected gear is present
Verification: Vehicle tests on the geofence's gradients; fault injection of door states and near-field reports

Technical safety requirement: Detect motion while holding before the vehicle has moved the creep distance P-03, and apply the park brake
Verification: Fault injection of a service brake release while holding on a gradient; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Allow reverse only at standstill, on request, and with CMP-03 reporting the rear near field clear
Verification: Fault injection of reverse requests in motion and with the rear near field occupied

Technical safety requirement: After a minimal risk condition, release the hold only on a signed release from the remote operations station and with the conditions of TSR-06.02 met
Verification: Fault injection of unsigned, replayed and premature release messages

Technical safety requirement: Compare the commanded turn indicator with the commanded and achieved steering direction, and switch to hazard lights within the indicator's flash period on a mismatch
Verification: Fault injection of indicator commands against steering

Technical safety requirement: Detect faults of the monitor's processor, memory and clock by lockstep cores, memory protection and an independent watchdog, with the diagnostic coverage ASIL D requires
Safety mechanism (WP-S-03): SM-08 Monitor self-diagnostics and fail-silent output
Verification: Hardware fault injection; diagnostic coverage analysis (WP-H-04)

Technical safety requirement: On a detected own fault, stop sending commands to the vehicle, so that MRM-5 starts after the silence P-08
Safety mechanism (WP-S-03): SM-08 Monitor self-diagnostics and fail-silent output
Verification: Fault injection with the output observed on the bus; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Detect road users and obstacles in and beside the swept path out to the range P-12 from LiDAR and radar returns by geometry and motion, without learned classification, counting a road user seen by either sensor, and report position, velocity and occluded zones with each frame
Verification: Detection tests across the ODD by day, night and in light rain; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Return points from road users and obstacles of the smallest size P-12 out to its range, in the ODD's light and weather, and in the near field down to the bumper in front and behind (FSR-05.01, FSR-05.03)
Verification: Sensor tests with reference targets at range; supplier evidence

Technical safety requirement: Return detections with radial velocity from road users and obstacles of the smallest size P-12 out to its range, in the ODD's light and weather, and in the near field down to the bumper in front and behind (FSR-05.01, FSR-05.03)
Verification: Sensor tests with reference targets at range; supplier evidence

Technical safety requirement: Keep false detections in the swept path from the LiDAR below its share P-13
Verification: False-detection rate from field and replay data, per sensor

Technical safety requirement: Keep false detections in the swept path from the radar below its share P-13
Verification: False-detection rate from field and replay data, per sensor

Technical safety requirement: Keep false detections in the swept path, after fusing both sensors, below the rate P-13 allows for the channel
Verification: False-detection rate from field and replay data, for the channel

Technical safety requirement: Detect faults of the safety channel processor itself (lockstep, ECC and watchdog on its safety island), and report itself failed to the monitor or fall silent, so that the monitor follows TSR-03.04
Verification: Hardware fault injection on the safety channel processor; diagnostic coverage analysis (WP-H-04); timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Detect blockage, misalignment, loss and degradation of each safety channel sensor and report it to the monitor, which starts TR-05
Verification: Fault injection of sensor faults; blockage tests with dirt, water and snow; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Cut propulsion on the monitor's command, whatever else is commanded
Verification: Supplier evidence under the DIA; vehicle test

Technical safety requirement: Keep a braking path that can stop the vehicle at no less than the braking P-06 assumes after any single fault in the primary one
Verification: Supplier evidence under the DIA; vehicle test with the primary path disabled

Technical safety requirement: Keep steering controllable after any single fault for at least the time of a stop in lane from the top ODD speed at the firm level P-05
Safety mechanism (WP-S-03): SM-13 Fault-tolerant steering for the stop
Verification: Supplier evidence under the DIA

Technical safety requirement: When the monitor's commands stop for longer than P-08, brake to a standstill and hold it, whatever Autoware sends
Safety mechanism (WP-S-03): SM-14 Stop on loss of the monitor
Verification: Vehicle test with the monitor disconnected; timing measurement

Technical safety requirement: Deliver speed and longitudinal acceleration to the monitor on a path that does not pass through the Autoware computer, with the sensors' own fault flags, at a rate that fits the detection budget
Verification: Supplier evidence; fault injection on the signal path

Technical safety requirement: Deliver steering angle to the monitor on the same independent path, with its own fault flag, at a rate that fits the detection budget
Verification: Supplier evidence; fault injection on the signal path

Technical safety requirement: Apply and hold the park brake on the monitor's command, on the steepest gradient of the geofence
Verification: Supplier evidence under the DIA; vehicle test on the steepest gradient

Technical safety requirement: Report the state of every door to the monitor and inhibit motion with any door open
Verification: Supplier evidence; vehicle test with each door

Technical safety requirement: Keep CMP-02, CMP-03, its sensors and the actuation path powered after any single fault of the Autoware computer's supply, for at least the time of MRM-4
Verification: Power fault injection

Technical safety requirement: Stamp every remote command and release with the synchronised time, number it in sequence and sign it (CSR-01) before it leaves the station
Verification: Interface test; cybersecurity verification (WP-W-11)
